name: Tokita Chise
source:
Kyousuke's niece born by his younger sister when she was only 16. She was too young to care for Chise and ran away when Chise was 3. Kyousuke raises her as his own daughter and she treats her cousins as sisters.

She is the youngest of the Tokita girls.
